McpServerDefinition.description: Sales rep + Revenue Cloud toolkit for RevOps / product-to-cash operations: daily rep digest, follow-up email, account/contact lookups, generic record read/write, RC business-API discovery, PCM structure, and a general standard-API caller.

tools.descriptionOverride: Builds an end-of-day digest for a sales rep: an account summary, today's call/task activity, a four-part opportunity summary (changed today, full pipeline by stage, won/lost today, renewals due within 14 days), and rule-based next-step suggestions each traceable to the rule that produced it -- then emails the digest to that rep. Scoped strictly to the accounts the rep owns; defaults to the calling user, or a specific rep by email if given.
Resolves a sales rep's Salesforce User Id and Name from their email address. A simple, direct lookup -- no digest data, just identity resolution.

Sends a customer follow-up email to a Contact immediately -- "Claude Send". Templated (pass emailTemplateId) or custom (pass subject + body). Before calling this, ask the rep whether they want Claude to send it now, or would rather review/edit and send it themselves in Salesforce (use getComposeEmailLink for that path instead). Call ONLY after the rep has explicitly confirmed the specific content and recipient AND chosen this send path -- never speculatively. This is an irreversible external action: it sends a real email and logs it to the Contact's Activity History.
Lists every active email template available for a customer follow-up, with its folder/category AND its full HTML body -- show the rep the actual content before they confirm a send.

Gets key details for one Account by Id -- industry, type, phone, website, employee count, owner -- plus its Contacts (so the number of contacts is just the length of that list). Use this to answer "tell me about this account" or before deciding who to email at it.
Lists every Contact on an Account by Id -- name, email, title. No single "primary contact" is designated -- if there are multiple contacts, ask the rep which one before calling sendCustomerEmail.

Builds a Salesforce record link for any object type from its Id -- works for Accounts, Opportunities, Tasks, Contacts, or anything else, no need to know the object type in advance. Use this to give the rep a clickable link to any record mentioned in a response.

Gets a flat summary of the standard fields on any record, given its sObject type and Id -- works generically for any object, not just the ones with a dedicated tool. Use this for "tell me about this record" when there's no more specific tool for that object type.

Builds a link to Salesforce's own Compose Email screen -- "Salesforce Send". Use this instead of sendCustomerEmail when the rep wants to review, edit, or personalize the content themselves before sending, rather than have Claude send it directly. Pass emailTemplateId if a template was already chosen in the conversation to skip straight to the compose screen.

Runs a SOQL query against any Salesforce object, respecting the calling rep's own permissions (same enforcement as the standard sobject-all server -- object CRUD, field-level security, and sharing rules all apply). Use this for ad hoc lookups no dedicated tool on this server covers.

Creates a new record for any Salesforce object, given its sObject type and a map of field values. This is a real, irreversible write -- call ONLY after the rep has explicitly confirmed the object type and field values; never speculatively.

Updates one or more fields on a single existing Salesforce record, identified by sObject type and Id. This is a real, irreversible write -- call ONLY after the rep has explicitly confirmed the specific record, field(s), and new value(s); never speculatively.

Updates one or more fields on a record related to a given parent record via a relationship path (e.g. update a Contact through an Account's relationship), without needing the related record's Id directly. This is a real, irreversible write -- call ONLY after the rep has explicitly confirmed the specific parent record, relationship, field(s), and new value(s); never speculatively.

Lists Revenue Cloud business-process APIs -- sales transaction/DRO, asset lifecycle, billing/invoicing/payments, usage/entitlements, and pricing -- each with its real endpoint, description, and live input/output schema where the platform exposes it. This tool only LISTS APIs, it does not call them: to actually call one, take its endpoint, httpMethod, and input schema from this response and pass them to invokeSalesforceApiActionTool on this same server.

Gets the full Product Catalog Management (PCM) structure for one product by Id or ProductCode -- attributes, classification, category, catalog, bundle/component structure, selling models, and pricebook entries, with every record Id included. Pass includeRampAndUsage=true to also fetch ramp segments and usage entitlement grants (a separate call).

Calls any standard, OOTB Salesforce REST/Connect API endpoint on this org given a path, HTTP method, and optional JSON body -- authenticates via a self-issued JWT Bearer token minted per-call for the calling user, so the resulting access token reflects the calling rep, not a fixed service account. For Revenue Cloud business-process APIs specifically, call bizApiCatalogServiceTool first to discover the real endpoint/method/schema -- don't guess a Revenue Cloud endpoint path. Call ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed the endpoint, method, and payload -- never speculatively, especially for non-GET calls.

Reads or edits any Salesforce record by Id -- no need to know the object type in advance. Omit fieldsToUpdateJson for a read; pass it (a JSON object of field API name -> new value, e.g. {"Industry":"Technology"}) to update the record first, then this returns the post-update state. Respects the calling user's own CRUD/FLS/sharing on both paths. Date/DateTime fields are not supported for update in this version. Call ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed the record and field values when updating -- never speculatively.
